params.body:
A trend is edited where it is read in full: the Studio's Curate tab links here (Edit ↗) instead of offering Hide beside every live trend.

- **Edit** beside the headline turns the headline and the three readings into fields; Save writes the changed ones through `/store/patch` (with `updated_at`), and gentells.com follows at its next reconcile.
- Under the headline, whether it is on gentells.com, taken off, or waiting, with **Take it off the site** or **Put it on the site** (the same `/site/trends/:id` decision the Studio used).
- The section labels on this page lose their spaced capitals.

Build ok, lint ratchet at its ceiling, e2e pass.
params.title: Trend page: edit, and on or off gentells.com
